# v2 conformance cases

One bulk request in, the v2 document hub3 sends to Elasticsearch out.

## Run

    go test ./ikuzo/service/x/bulk/ -run TestConformance           # check
    go test ./ikuzo/service/x/bulk/ -run TestConformance -update   # rewrite goldens

`-update` rewrites `NNNN.json` / `NNNN.error.json` only. Review the diff:
every golden change is a behaviour change.

Configuration: hub3's defaults, except `[rdftag]`, which comes from
`rdftag.toml`, the NDE config (which predicates are labels, titles, creators,
…). The goldens show what NDE indexes; a change to that file changes them.

## A case

- `NNNN.<nt|ttl|rdf|jsonld>`: the record graph; the extension is its mime type.
- `NNNN.json`: the expected v2 `_source`, `meta.modified` set to 0, 2-space indent.
- `NNNN.error.json`: `{"kind":"<stage>"}` instead, when hub3 refuses the record.
- `NNNN.bulk.json` (optional): envelope fields over `envelope.json`.
- `formats/NNNN.<fmt>`: the same graph in another format; must give the same
  document apart from `order`, blank-node labels and array order. No goldens.

## Ranges

| Range | Contents |
|---|---|
| 00xx | literals |
| 01xx | resource structure |
| 02xx | types and the root |
| 03xx | envelope |
| 05xx | rich corpus, schema.org |
| 06xx | rich corpus, CIDOC-CRM (mirrors 05xx) |
| 08xx | errors and limits |
| 09xx | real records |

## Other formats

    PY="nix shell --impure --expr 'with import (builtins.getFlake \"nixpkgs\") {}; python3.withPackages (p: [p.rdflib])' -c python3 -I"
    eval $PY ikuzo/service/x/bulk/testdata/conformance/formats.py ikuzo/service/x/bulk/testdata/conformance [NNNN ...]

Regenerate after changing an `.nt` in 00xx–02xx or 05xx–06xx and commit the result.

## Rich corpus (05xx schema.org, 06xx CIDOC-CRM)

Generated by `corpus.py` (edit it, rerun it, rerun `formats.py` and `-update`).
06xx states the same facts as 05xx: `06NN` mirrors `05NN`. 06xx uses
`recDefId` `crm` (root `E22_Human-Made_Object`).

| # | Record | Role |
|---|---|---|
| 0501 | oak panel, 1660, by Pieter (born Leiden 1620, died Amsterdam 1675, pupil of Jacob), about Maria | hit |
| 0502 | as 0501, 1685 | miss on date |
| 0503 | by Paulus, died in Haarlem | miss on place of death |
| 0504 | on canvas | miss on material |
| 0505 | by Adriaen, pupil of Claes | miss on teacher |
| 0506 | about Willem | miss on subject |
| 0507 | by the teacher Jacob, 1650 | next level of the chain |
| 0508 | date `1660-03-12` (xsd:date) | shape: full date |
| 0509 | birthplace as the literal "Leyden" | shape: place as text |
| 0510 | painter as an external IRI, not in the graph | shape: external creator |
| 0511 | date "ca. 1660" | shape: date as text |
| 0512 | material as the literal "eikenhouten paneel" | shape: material as text |

Places: Leiden, Amsterdam, Haarlem → Holland → Republiek, with names in
nl/en/fr/la (`schema:name` + `schema:alternateName`; in CRM one `E41_Appellation`
per name, typed preferred/alternative).

CRM modelling: production `E12` → `P4` `E52` → `P82a`/`P82b`; technique
`P32` → `E55` → `P2_has_type` → `E55 "techniek"`; material `P45` → `E57` →
`P2` → `E55 "materiaal"`; birth/death `P98i`/`P100i` → `E67`/`E69` → `P7` →
`E53` → `P89`; teacher via `P14i_performed` → `E7` training → `P01i_is_domain_of`
→ `PC14_carried_out_by` → `P02_has_range` + `P14.1_in_the_role_of`
(`leerling`/`leermeester`), the CRM RDF pattern for a property of a property.

## Queries for later

Expected hit sets over the corpus. Shape variants (0508–0512 / 0608–0612)
are listed where they *should* hit; whether they do is what the follow-up
measures.

| Q | Question | Expected hits |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 | oak panel, made 1660, by a painter born in Leiden (or Leyden), died in Amsterdam, pupil of Jacob, about Maria | 0501, 0601, 0508, 0608, 0509, 0609, 0511, 0611, 0512, 0612 |
| Q2 | made in 1660 | 0501, 0503–0506, 0508–0512 and the 06xx mirrors |
| Q3 | painter died in Haarlem | 0503, 0603 |
| Q4 | painter pupil of Claes | 0505, 0605 |
| Q5 | made on canvas | 0504, 0604 |
| Q6 | about Willem | 0506, 0606 |
| Q7 | painter born in a place within Holland | every record with a painter in the graph (all but 0510/0610, and 0509/0609 only through the text "Leyden") |
| Q8 | name "Leyde" (French) finds the place Leiden | every record containing Leiden as a place |

## Query assumptions to test

Each is a belief our search code relies on; the CRM corpus is meant to break some.

| A | Assumption |
|---|---|
| A1 | The technique is the value of the entry with the technique search label, or in the resource it points at. (CRM: the meaning "technique" is on `P2_has_type` of the type.) |
| A2 | A date of creation is at `level` ≤ 2. (CRM: `P82a` is at level 3.) |
| A3 | A place's name is found through label resolution on the entry that points at the place. (CRM: names are on `E41` appellations, one hop further.) |
| A4 | A person's role (pupil/teacher) is expressed by the predicate. (CRM: by `P14.1_in_the_role_of` on a `PC14` node.) |
| A5 | Alternative names in other languages are searchable as values of the place. |
| A6 | A value given as text instead of a resource (0509, 0511, 0512) is found by the same query as the resource form. |
